verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean velocity is χ_t(t) • (curl(χ_x𝒜) + χ_x·D), where D is the direct angular field that plays the role of ℬe_θ (LocalPaper.Properties pairs u^loc = curl A + D with D equal to DirectAngularDiagonal.angularField of a scalar). Since χ_t does not depend on x, χ_t·curl(χ_x𝒜) = curl(χ_tχ_x𝒜) = curl(c𝒜) and χ_tχ_x D = cℬe_θ, so the two expressions agree pointwise; the pressure is literally χ_tχ_x p^loc. The only difference is the order of the two cutoffs and the fact that the angular part is cut with the scalar multiplication cutPotential rather than written as cℬ e_θ in polar components.
